//: THE ESTATES (GDD §6.1 factions; Democracy-4-style interest groups). Each estate holds an approval of the player's house, −100..100, drifting toward what the house's laws say about it (sum of each enacted option's opinion of the estate) plus whatever events have cultivated (counter estate_offset:<id>, which decays). Past +30 an estate is LOYAL and its loyal effects apply to the house; under −30 it is HOSTILE and its hostile effects apply. Effects are modifier keys PolicySystem adds to the house's laws: credits_per_world, materials_per_world, manpower_per_world, unrest_drift, prosperity_drift, pop_growth, lawlessness_drift, allegiance_drift, venture_yield_pct, charter_pct, market_price_pct, fleet_upkeep_pct, readiness, senate_weight, legitimacy_per_5, motion_cost, tolls_bonus.

estates.name: The Commons
estates.description: The people of your worlds: farmers, dockhands, the crews. They want bread, fair courts and sons who come home.

estates.name: The Merchants
estates.description: Factors, shipping lines, the counting-houses. They want open lanes, low tariffs and a market that does not ask questions.

estates.name: The Officers
estates.description: The captains and the crews of your hulls. They want a standing guard, a doctrine with teeth, and pay that arrives.

estates.name: The Old Blood
estates.description: The titled houses and their clients. They want ceremony kept, the ballot closed, and the upjumped kept in their place.

estates.name: The Magistrates
estates.description: The clerks, the courts, the collectors. They want iron law, orderly tithes and a chancery that respects procedure.

estates.name: The Frontier
estates.description: Belt-rats, free companies, the homesteaders of the rim. They want open lanes, open land and no patrols asking for papers.
